newsitem.title: USA: Temple-Inland mortgage unit buys Knutson.
newsitem.headline: Temple-Inland mortgage unit buys Knutson.

text.p: Temple-Inland Mortgage Corp said it has acquired all of the issued and outstanding capital stock of Knutson Mortgage Corp from its sole shareholder.
The company said the deal brings Temple-Inland's servicing portfolio to over $24 billion and gives the company a foothold in the Midwest.
The company did not disclose a purchase price.

KMC Management Co, a mortgage banking organization based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, services over $6 billion in mortgage loans. Temple-Inland Mortgage will provide servicing for these newly acquired loans by continuing to operate the servicing facility in Minneapolis, the company said..
Temple-Inland Mortgage Corp is a subsidiary of Guaranty Federal Bank, F.S.B., which is a subsidiary of Temple-Inland Inc.
